I enjoyed Karen getting her due way too much.
Still gotta say the truth that if she were black, she'd be in the morgue not arrested #BlackLivesMatter

For #ComfortWomen #BlackLivesMatter #FirstNations #IndigenousPeoples #Slavery We need to teach our next generation the sins of our past so they move forward, grow together. Erasing plants seeds of immoral temptation to repeat wht we've done to one another. We're better than this.
